picks.name: Maxime Denuc
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Light-Years. Similar genre-blurring classical/dance territory to your Second Storey and Christian Löffler picks.
picks.bio: "Club Imperiale" (September 11, 2026, Light-Years) is a work of speculative historical fiction -- ten compositions for a MIDI-controlled pipe organ, recorded at St. Antonius Church in Düsseldorf, drawing on 1990s trance and techno.
picks.why_listen: A genuinely strange, singular concept record -- organ-driven takes on rave melodies make for a striking intro or late-set curveball.

picks.name: Klara Lewis
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Editions Mego. Similar ambient/experimental territory to your Bitchin Bajas and Argento picks.
picks.bio: "Opening" (September 4, 2026, Editions Mego) is a 13-track album of abstract, experimental electronic composition.
picks.why_listen: Dense, abstract ambient textures from a veteran Editions Mego artist -- good for intros, warmups or a headier interlude.
